name: Memory Recall Optimizer
description: Hook-only plugin that reinforces memory_search behavior and improves recall observability.

enabled.label: Enable memory recall optimizer
enabled.help: Enable all plugin hooks for memory recall optimization.

enforceMemorySearchTuning.label: Enforce memory_search tuning
enforceMemorySearchTuning.help: Enforce minimum maxResults and minScore when memory_search is called.

prePromptGuard.label: Inject memory recall prompt hint
prePromptGuard.help: Inject a short recall hint for memory-oriented turns.

maxResults.label: Default maxResults
maxResults.help: Minimum maxResults enforced for memory_search calls.

minScore.label: Default minScore
minScore.help: Minimum memory_search similarity threshold enforced when tuning.

logMemorySearchSummary.label: Log memory_search summary
logMemorySearchSummary.help: Log memory_search hit count and disabled state after each call.
